# MZ

> Model Zero for Technology Solutions (MZ) is a Cairo-based software and AI company. It builds custom systems and trains teams to run them, informed by applied research.

## Primary pages

- [MZ home](https://www.mzfortech.com/): Studio overview.
- [Work](https://www.mzfortech.com/work): Selected software projects and products.
- [Services](https://www.mzfortech.com/services): Software engineering, deployment, and knowledge transfer.
- [About MZ](https://www.mzfortech.com/intel): Studio approach and background.
- [Contact](https://www.mzfortech.com/contact): Project inquiries.
- [The Null Hypothesis research portal](https://www.mzfortech.com/research): MZ's published research.
- [Research in Arabic](https://www.mzfortech.com/research/ar): Arabic edition of the research portal.
- [Plain-text site summary](https://www.mzfortech.com/content.md): Machine-readable overview of the studio and selected work.
- [XML sitemap](https://www.mzfortech.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical pages available for crawling.

## What MZ does

MZ builds custom software and AI systems, helps deploy them, and trains client teams to operate them. Applied research informs its products and client work.

MZ is based in Cairo, Egypt. Contact: [hello@mzfortech.com](mailto:hello@mzfortech.com).

## Products and research

- **Occhio** is an Arabic-first OCR system in development, designed for Arabic, French, and English institutional documents.
- **The Null Hypothesis** is MZ's research publication. Its published study examines statistical compression of VGG19 for BloodMNIST blood-cell image classification using L1 regularization, structured L0 gates, and low-rank SVD.

## Selected work

- [Nested United case study](https://www.mzfortech.com/work/nested-united): MZ's work on a digital platform for Nested United.
- [Nested United website](https://nestedunited.com/): The client website.

The public machine-readable resources are this file, [content.md](https://www.mzfortech.com/content.md), and the [sitemap](https://www.mzfortech.com/sitemap.xml). The site does not expose a public OpenAPI, MCP, OAuth, commerce, or payment API.
